prompt: An ancient Egyptian map of the Nile and the lands of the dead painted on an aged, stained papyrus: the river winding from top to bottom, small pyramids, temples, palms and boats along it, the desert in faded ochre, ibises and a small sun-boat in the margins, in faded ink and soft washes of lapis, turquoise, ochre and gold. The centre is mostly open desert and river with very few marks so game icons can sit on top. Made by hand like a 1993 fantasy game-book illustration: bold, wobbly black pen-and-ink outlines, thin flat transparent watercolour washes with blotchy hard edges, a little cross-hatching, rough off-white paper grain showing through; ancient Egyptian, New Kingdom, with the flat bright colours of tomb painting (lapis, turquoise, red ochre, gold, palm green); colourful rather than muddy. No Greek, Norse or Chinese elements. No text, no readable hieroglyphs.
